actual_roundtrip.method: Every actual old/new forward capture was fed to its respective complete old/new dictionary via both real JA and ZH inverse functions. Expected text is the forward test's circumflex source with case folded, matching the inverse app contract. No output normalization. The only reviewed policy differences are two exact raw-protected-kanji inputs in current: the displayed text is preserved but plain inverse conversion has no marker provenance. Both exact before/after strings are asserted; every other mismatch/change remains a regression. One approved assignment in current only; shared owners and fixed legacy remain unchanged. Annotation glosses and source-side ruby text remain unchanged.

protected_plain_text.note: Percent protection is preserved by forward conversion. Plain output has no protection provenance, so literal kanji are interpreted by the selected inverse dictionary; standard HTML recovery retains the original literals.
